title: the Kuiper Line Rising Revisited
author: M. M. Hartwell
blurb: Freya Lockridge, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
